in_hebrew.name: Cullan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cullan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish word ‘cú’ meaning hound or warrior and ‘lan’ meaning lover or little one. In Irish mythology, Cúchulainn is a legendary hero, a powerful warrior and hunter.

in_greek.name: Cullan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong warrior
in_greek.long_meaning: Cullan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Irish word ‘cú’ meaning hound or warrior and ‘lan’ meaning lover or little one. In Irish mythology, Cúchulainn is a legendary hero, a powerful warrior and hunter.

in_latin.name: Cullan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong warrior
in_latin.long_meaning: Cullan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Irish word ‘cú’ meaning hound or warrior and ‘lan’ meaning lover or little one. In Irish mythology, Cúchulainn is a legendary hero, a powerful warrior and hunter.
